source.stem:
Aluminium is used to make containers for storing food.

Which property makes it suitable for this use?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: A planet revolving around another star in the Milky Way is a galaxy.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: On a moonless night, the Milky Way band is equally easy to see from a brightly lit city and a dark countryside location.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The Milky Way Galaxy is inside the Solar System.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: There cannot be any exoplanets in other galaxies.

intelligence.enrichment: The Milky Way is our home galaxy and can appear as a faint band of light from a very dark moonless location; beyond it there are many galaxies, and exoplanets are planets discovered revolving around other stars in our galaxy, while life elsewhere in the Universe is not yet known. Moving outward from the Solar System leads first to our galaxy, then to other galaxies; planets around other stars are exoplanets, but finding such planets does not by itself show that life exists there. The learner correctly applies this rule: The Milky Way is our home galaxy and can appear as a faint band of light from a very dark moonless location; beyond it there are many galaxies, and exoplanets are planets discovered revolving around other stars in our galaxy, while life elsewhere in the Universe is not yet known. Anything beyond the Solar System is just a far star, so galaxies, exoplanets, and evidence of life are the same idea.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Beyond Earth. The student must decide: Organize objects beyond the Solar System into the Milky Way Galaxy, other galaxies, exoplanets, and the still-open question of life elsewhere. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
